'''Waleutto Yobariok''' was an eccentric merchant who lived prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was said to have been served by a [[Waleutto Yobariok's protocol droid|gold-plated]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] in his [[Waleutto Yobariok's estate|mansion]], a rumor that was confirmed when treasure hunters discovered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the estate's basement.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Extravagant Possessions}}</ref>
